## PHASE 8 SKELETON — DO NOT ACTIVATE

**active: false** — This workflow must remain inactive until:
1. All REPLACE_WITH_* credential placeholders are replaced with real credentials
2. All REPLACE_WITH_* data fields are filled with real values
3. Owner has reviewed and approved the workflow
4. Codex has reviewed and issued PASS

**CRITICAL — NO ADS SPEND:**
This workflow produces an ads pack DRAFT only.
No ads budget can be committed until Owner sets approval_status=Approved.
All publishing and launch nodes are NoOp stubs — permanently disabled.

**HARD CONSTRAINTS:**
- No auto-publishing of ads
- No ad budget committed at any step
- No Meta / TikTok / Zalo Ads API calls in skeleton
- Approval Gate is mandatory
- Logging step is mandatory
- Compliance notes required in every ads pack output

**Blueprint:** runtime-blueprints/n8n/content-auto-blueprint.md
